items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: This fella by the name of Smith. Harlan Smith. He said, Joe, I said, sir. He said, yeah, I'll give you a schedule for tomorrow.

ctx.x: bands at all or any of the other musicians around that we could look at? No, I had some pictures here but then that fella

there and you never know them to play in no band. No musicians? I was working no musicians. He just got there. I think that's the picture there. Over there. Two tall fellas. They used to work at the theater where I worked at. I used to work at the theater too. The singer theater. Yeah, I worked there ten years. That's my last job I had. I had a time getting away from there. That fella had them all tied up, you understand? And I was working at that time piece, piece work. And every time he'd give me a... He said,…
What kind of work did you do? There was a piece work.
